layout.always_center_hint: Center a lone column even when the policy says otherwise.
layout.default_column_width_hint: Proportion of the viewport a freshly opened tiled column takes.
layout.empty_above_hint: Keeps the empty workspace column above workspace 1.
layout.empty_description: This config has no layout block, so niri uses its own defaults. Add one to edit gaps, column width and the centering policy here.
layout.preview_note: Drawn from the values on the right against a 1920px viewport. The fields stay authoritative.

input.device_absent: There is no {{device}} block in this config, so niri uses its defaults.
input.drag_hint: Tap-and-drag; niri requires the explicit true/false argument.
input.dwtp_hint: Disable the pad while typing, palm detection only.
input.empty_description: This config has no input block, so niri uses its built-in defaults for every device. Add the block to start tuning a keyboard, touchpad or pointer.
input.focus_follows_hint: Focus the window under the pointer. niri has no false spelling; off removes the node.
input.kdl_note: A flag left at niri default is omitted; an explicit off is written as a commented-out node, which niri reads as absent.
input.numlock_hint: niri accepts a bare node, true or false here.
input.off_hint: Hide the device from niri entirely.
input.repeat_delay_hint: Milliseconds before a held key repeats (0–65535).
input.tablet_absent: No tablet block in this config.
input.tablet_hint: This build models the off flag only; the other tablet keys stay in the file untouched.
input.tap_hint: A single-finger tap is a left click.
input.touch_absent: No touch block in this config.
input.touch_hint: This build models the off flag only; the other touch keys stay in the file untouched.
input.warp_hint: Move the pointer to a window focused from the keyboard.
input.xkb_absent: No xkb block: the layout comes from the system defaults.

binds.args_hint: Used by spawn and spawn-sh; other actions usually take none.
binds.editor_description: A chord is written as key names joined by +, for example Mod+Shift+Q. The action is the niri action to run.
binds.editor_duplicate: Another binding already uses this chord. Saving both keeps niri's own behaviour for repeated chords; resolve it here if that is not intended.
binds.empty_description: This config has no binds, so niri falls back to its own defaults. Add a binding to run a compositor action, launch a program, or switch workspaces from the keyboard.
binds.heatmap_note: number is how many binds name the key
binds.kdl_note: The list keeps its config order; copied text can be pasted back into a binds block unchanged.
binds.search_placeholder: filter by hotkey (e.g. mod+shift) or action (e.g. spawn)

window_rules.empty_description: This config has no window-rule blocks, so niri treats every window with its global defaults. Add a rule to send specific apps floating, maximized, or hidden from screen capture.
window_rules.order_note: drag a row or use the arrows
window_rules.select_description: Pick a rule from the pipeline to edit its match criteria and properties.

layer_rules.empty_description: This config has no layer-rule blocks, so every layer-shell surface (docks, bars, notification daemons, lock screens) is placed by its client. Add a rule to set a layer, anchor, margins or keyboard interactivity.
layer_rules.namespace_required: A layer rule without a namespace matches nothing useful. Set the namespace its client announces.
layer_rules.order_note: drag a row or use the arrows
layer_rules.select_description: Pick a namespace from the list to edit its shell placement.

animations.empty_description: This config has no animations block, so niri runs every transition with its built-in defaults. Turn on animations above or pick a slot to write one.
animations.kdl_empty: Nothing to write: this config has no animations node yet.
animations.no_slots_description: Every slot is unset, which means all of them use niri defaults. Choose a slot below to give one its own duration and motion.
animations.select_slot: Pick a slot to edit its motion.

workspaces.duplicate_name: Another workspace already uses this name.
workspaces.empty_description: This config declares no workspace blocks. niri still has workspaces, they are just unnamed and unpinned — a block here only appears once you give one a name.
workspaces.hotkeys_hint: Bindings are edited on the Key Bindings page.
workspaces.no_hotkeys: No bind in this config targets a workspace by name.
workspaces.output_hint: Options come from config.outputs. A name niri reports at runtime but has no block for is not listed here.
workspaces.select: Pick a workspace from the list above.

startup.app_policy_hint: How this app reaches niri and how it touches the file. niri has no node for any of it, so it is stored by NiriForge and never written to config.kdl.
startup.empty_description: Nothing here is set, so niri starts with its own defaults: no spawned processes and no exported variables. Adding a command above writes a spawn-at-startup line.
startup.environment_hint: Keys with no value are written as null, which unsets the variable for spawned processes.
startup.kdl_empty: Nothing to write: niri keeps its own defaults for every startup node.
startup.no_processes: This config spawns nothing at startup.
startup.processes_hint: Order matters: niri runs these in sequence at startup. Editing a line here never launches it.
startup.shell_hint: A shell line is handed to sh -c, so quoting and redirection are interpreted by the shell.

gestures.activation_token_hint: Focus a window by the XDG activation token it was launched with.
gestures.debug_hint: These are written to config.kdl and read by niri at load. A higher log level slows the compositor down; dump-frames writes images to disk.
gestures.diagnostics_hint: Answers come from the running compositor over its IPC socket. Nothing here is stored, and the copy holds these answers only — no config, no environment, no commands.
gestures.disable_scanout_hint: Hand every frame through the compositor instead of scanning out directly.
gestures.dnd_view_scroll_hint: Drag from the edge to scroll into the adjacent column.
gestures.dnd_workspace_hint: Drag from the edge to move to the next workspace instead.
gestures.dump_frames_hint: Write every rendered frame to disk as an image.
gestures.empty_description: No gestures node, no switch events, no debug block — niri is running on its own defaults. A switch above writes the matching node to config.kdl.
gestures.empty_list: Empty list: the event is defined and does nothing.
gestures.hot_corners_hint: One action string per corner, in the same syntax as a key binding action. Leave a field empty to keep the niri default.
gestures.kdl_empty: No node to write: every field above is at its niri default.
gestures.probe_failed: At least one command could not answer, so niri is likely not running or this build has no IPC support. The values above are only what came back.
gestures.switch_events_hint: Commands niri runs when the lid opens or closes, or when the machine enters or leaves tablet mode. Unset events are left to niri.
gestures.touch_hint: These two flags decide whether a drag at the screen edge pans a column, switches workspace, or does nothing. niri's own defaults apply while they are unset.
gestures.unset_hint: No commands. Typing one here and pressing Arm writes an empty list first.

raw_kdl.apply_unavailable: Parsing arbitrary KDL into the typed model needs a parse command the backend does not expose yet. Use the visual pages for structural edits; this page writes the model, not the text.
raw_kdl.cursor_pending: draft not applied to the model
raw_kdl.description: Edit the config as KDL text. No network access is required.
raw_kdl.diagnostics_hint: Run Validate to check the loaded config against niri's own parser.
raw_kdl.discard_draft: Discard the draft and re-read the model
raw_kdl.includes_empty: This config has no include nodes, so there is one file to read.
raw_kdl.no_config_hint: Load a config file to see its KDL source. The raw view works on whatever is currently loaded.
raw_kdl.sync_direction: The typed model is the source of truth on the way in: writing it to disk serialises the whole config, so free-form edits in this buffer are not parsed back into the model.
raw_kdl.title: Raw KDL

app_settings.about_text: A native configuration dashboard for the niri scrollable-tiling Wayland compositor.
app_settings.appearance_hint: Interface theme of the app window.
app_settings.backup_before_save_hint: A timestamped backup is taken before files are replaced.
app_settings.backups_link: Snapshots themselves are listed, restored and pruned on the Backups page.
app_settings.description: Preferences of the NiriForge app: language, compositor integration and save safeguards.
app_settings.isolation_hint: None of these settings are niri configuration. They are stored by the app and never make config.kdl dirty.
app_settings.niri_integration_hint: How the app reaches the compositor. Overrides are local to NiriForge.
app_settings.safety_hint: What happens before the app touches a file on disk.
app_settings.theme_dark_hint: The only theme this build ships.
app_settings.theme_pending: Light and system themes are not implemented yet, so they are not offered here.
app_settings.title: App Settings
app_settings.validate_before_save_hint: Refuses to write a config that niri cannot parse.

backups.confirm_delete_hint: The snapshot file is removed from disk. This cannot be undone.
backups.confirm_restore_hint: The files on disk are replaced by this snapshot and the config is reloaded. The backend validates the candidate first and leaves the current files alone if it does not pass.
backups.create_named_hint: Freezes the config files currently on disk into a named restore point.
backups.description: Snapshots of the config files, restore points and what is stored on disk.
backups.empty_hint: Snapshots appear here once the config has been saved with a backup, or when one is created by hand.
backups.files_empty: The backend reported no file list.
backups.inspector_empty: Pick a snapshot to see what it holds.
backups.name: Name
backups.profiles_hint: Restoring a snapshot reloads the model from disk.
backups.profiles_unavailable: There is no profile store on the backend yet, so there is nothing to switch between. A snapshot plus a restore is the equivalent for now.
backups.retention_unavailable: Pruning is decided by the backend when a save takes a backup; no retention limit is configurable from the app yet.
backups.title: Backups & Profiles
